definitions.explanation: Trust or confidence placed in a person, especially in a political or organizational context. Often refers to the formal trust bestowed upon a leader, diplomat, or official.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧{信任|しんにん}⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The vote of confidence in the cabinet was passed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{信任|しんにん}{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。

⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信任|しんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧{総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}った→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧。
examples.english: To gain a mandate from the people, the prime minister decided on a snap general election.

notes:
A formal political and diplomatic term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信任|しんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (gain confidence/trust)
- {信任|しんにん}{状|じょう} (credentials — diplomatic document)
- {信任|しんにん}⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (vote of confidence)
- {不信任|ふしんにん}⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (vote of no confidence)
- {不信任|ふしんにん}⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧ (no-confidence resolution)

The opposite, {不信任|ふしんにん} (no confidence), is more commonly seen in news, as votes of no confidence are more newsworthy than votes of confidence.
